verses.text: “Una no go make idols for yourselves, neither go una rear up for yourselves one carved image, or one pillar, neither go una set up any figured stone for una land, to bow down to am, because I na di Lord una God.
Una go keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary. I na di Lord.
If una waka for my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do dem,
I go give una rains for dem season, and di land go yield im increase, and di trees of di field go yield dem fruit.
Una threshing go reach to di vintage, and di vintage go reach to di sowing time. Una go eat una bread to di full, and dwell for una land in safety.
I go give peace for di land, and una go lie down, and none go make una afraid. I go cause evil animals to cease out of di land, and di sword no go go through una land.
Una go chase una enemies, and dem go fall before una by di sword.
Five of una go chase 100, and 100 of una go chase 10,000. Una enemies go fall before una by di sword.
I go have respect for una, and make una fruitful, and multiply una, and establish my covenant with una.
Una go eat old store long kept, and clear out di old to make room for di new.
I go set my tabernacle among una, and my soul no go abhor una.
I go waka among una, and go be una God, and una go be my people.
I na di Lord una God, wey bring una out of di land of Egypt, so that una no go be dem slaves. I don break di bars of una yoke, and make una go upright.
But if una no listen to me, and no do all dem commandments,
and if una reject my statutes, and if una soul abhor my ordinances, so that una no do all my commandments, but break my covenant,
I too go do dis to una: I go appoint terror over una, even consumption and fever, wey go consume di eyes, and make di soul dey grieved. Una go sow una seed in vain, because una enemies go eat am.
I go set my face against una, and una go dey struck before una enemies. Dem wey hate una go reign over una, and una go flee when nobody dey pursue una.
If una for all dis still no listen to me, I go punish una seven times more for una sins.
I go break di pride of una power. I go make una heaven like iron, and una earth like bronze.
Una strength go dey spent in vain, because una land no go yield im increase, neither go di trees of di land yield dem fruit.
If una waka contrary to me, and no go listen to me, I go bring seven times more plagues on una according to una sins.
I go send wild animals among una, wey go rob una of una pikin dem, and destroy una livestock, and make una few in number. Una roads go dey desolate.
If by dem things una no dey reformed to me, but waka contrary to me,
I too go waka contrary to una. I go strike una, even I, seven times for una sins.

I go bring one sword on una, wey go execute di vengeance of di covenant. Una go dey gathered together within una cities, and I go send pestilence among una. Una go dey delivered into di hand of di enemy.
When I break di staff of una bread, ten women go bake una bread for one oven, and dem go deliver una bread again by weight. Una go eat, and no dey satisfied.
If una for all dis no listen to me, but waka contrary to me,
I go waka contrary to una for fury. I too go chastise una seven times for una sins.
Una go eat di flesh of una pikin man dem, and una go eat di flesh of una pikin woman dem.
I go destroy una high places, and cut down una incense altars, and cast una dead bodies on di bodies of una idols. My soul go abhor una.
I go lay una cities waste, and bring una sanctuaries to desolation. I no go smell di pleasing aroma of una offerings.
I go bring di land into desolation. Una enemies wey dwell for am go dey astonished at am.
I go scatter una among di nations, and I go draw out one sword after una. Una land go be desolate, and una cities go be waste.
Di land go enjoy im Sabbaths, as long as e lie desolate, and una dey for una enemies land. Di land go rest, and enjoy im Sabbaths.
As long as e lie desolate e go rest, even wetin e no rest for una Sabbaths, when una dwell upon am.

As for dem wey remain of una, I go send faintness into dem hearts for di lands of dem enemies. Di sound of one shaken leaf go chase dem. Dem go flee, as one dey flee from di sword. Dem go fall when nobody dey pursue.
Dem go stumble over one another, as before di sword, when nobody dey pursue. Una go get no power to stand before una enemies.
Una go perish among di nations, and di land of una enemies go eat una up.
Dem wey remain of una go pine away for dem iniquity for di lands of una enemies. Also for di iniquities of dem papa dem dem go pine away with dem.
If dem confess dem iniquity, and di iniquity of dem papa dem, for dem treachery wey dem commit against me, and also say dem don waka contrary to me,
I also don waka contrary to dem, and bring dem into di land of dem enemies. If dem uncircumcised heart dey humbled, and dem accept di punishment of dem iniquity,
I go remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham I go remember, and I go remember di land.

Di land go dey left by dem, and go enjoy im Sabbaths, while e lie desolate without dem. Dem go accept di punishment of dem iniquity, because dem despise my ordinances, and because dem soul abhor my statutes.
Yet for all dat, when dem dey for di land of dem enemies, I no go reject dem, neither go I abhor dem, to destroy dem utterly, and to break my covenant with dem, because I na di Lord dem God.
But I go for dem sake remember di covenant of dem ancestors, wey I bring out of di land of Egypt for di sight of di nations, so that I go be dem God. I na di Lord.’”
Dem na di statutes, di ordinances, and di laws, wey di Lord make between am and di pikin dem of Israel for Mount Sinai by di hand of Moses.
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, and tell dem, ‘When one man make one special vow, di persons go be di Lord own by your valuation.
Your valuation for di male from 20 years old even to 60 years old go be 50 shekels of silver, after di shekel of di sanctuary.
If na female, your valuation go be 30 shekels.
If e be from five years old even to 20 years old, your valuation go be for di male 20 shekels, and for di female ten shekels.
If e be from one month old even to five years old, your valuation go be for di male five shekels of silver, and for di female your valuation go be three shekels of silver.
If e be from 60 years old and above, if e be male, your valuation go be 15 shekels, and for di female ten shekels.
But if e dey poorer than your valuation, e go dey presented before di priest, and di priest go value am. According to di means of im wey vow, di priest go value am.
If e be one animal, from wey men offer one offering to di Lord, all wey any man give of such to di Lord go be holy.
E no go change am, nor exchange am, good for bad, or bad for good. If e at all exchange animal for animal, both di one and di one wey dem exchange for am go be holy.
If e be any unclean animal, from wey dem no dey offer one offering to di Lord, e go present di animal before di priest.
Di priest go value am, whether e good or bad. As you, di priest, value am, so e go be.
But if e want at all to redeem am, e go add one fifth part to your valuation.
When one man make im house holy to be di Lord own, di priest go value am, whether e good or bad. As di priest go value am, so e go stand.
If im wey make am holy want to redeem im house, e go add di fifth part of di money of your valuation to am, and e go be im own.
If one man make holy to di Lord part of di field of im possession, your valuation go be according to di seed for am. One homer of barley seed go be at 50 shekels of silver.
If e make im field holy from di year of jubilee, e go stand according to your valuation.
But if e make im field holy after di jubilee, di priest go reckon to am di money according to di years wey remain until di year of jubilee, and e go dey abated from your valuation.
If im wey make di field holy want at all to redeem am, e go add di fifth part of di money of your valuation to am, and e go dey assured to am.
If e no redeem di field, or if e don sell di field to another man, e no go dey redeemed any more.
But di field, when e go out for di jubilee, go be holy to di Lord, as one field wey dem don devote. Di possession of am go be di priest own.
If e make holy to di Lord one field wey e don buy, wey no be part of di field of im possession,
di priest go reckon to am di worth of your valuation, even to di year of jubilee, and e go give your valuation on dat day, as one holy thing to di Lord.
For di year of jubilee di field go return to am from whom e buy am, even to am to whom di possession of di land belong.
All your valuations go be according to di shekel of di sanctuary. 20 gerahs go be di shekel.
Only di firstborn of di animals, wey dey di Lord own firstborn, no man go make holy. Whether ox or sheep, e na di Lord own.
If e be of one unclean animal, e go ransom am according to your valuation, and go add to am di fifth part of am. Or if e no dey redeemed, e go dey sold according to your valuation.
Nevertheless no devoted thing, wey one man devote to di Lord of all wey e get, of man or animal, or of di field of im possession, go dey sold or redeemed. Every devoted thing na most holy to di Lord.
No one devoted, wey dem go devote from among men, go dey ransomed. E go surely dey put to death.
All di tithe of di land, of di seed of di land, or of di fruit of di trees, na di Lord own. E dey holy to di Lord.
If one man want to redeem any of im tithe, e go add to am di fifth part of am.
All di tithe of di herd or di flock, whatever pass under di rod, di tenth go be holy to di Lord.
E no go examine whether e good or bad, neither go e exchange am. If e exchange am at all, both am and wetin e exchange for am go be holy. E no go dey redeemed.’”
Dem na di commandments, wey di Lord command Moses for di pikin dem of Israel for Mount Sinai.
